observations.any_other_difference: A4F0 has a small ">" chevron at the end of the 出所 line ("週次同期・田中・10:42 >") that is absent in 7D2B and E916
observations.content_lost: the ">" chevron after the timestamp in the 出所 line is present in A4F0 but missing in both 7D2B and E916; no other text or element differs

why.visual_craft: 7D2B and E916 are visually identical as far as I can tell and both look clean; A4F0 adds an extra chevron glyph that is not clearly justified and slightly clutters the 出所 row, so it is ranked last, though the gap is small
why.coherence: corner rounding of the amber button could not be distinguished across the three images, so I cannot judge whether it agrees with the card's own corner radius; ranking here is based on the same tie-break as overall (absence of the extra chevron) rather than a coherence judgment I could actually verify
why.overall: 7D2B and E916 appear pixel-for-pixel equivalent to my eye, placed first on no distinguishing evidence between them; A4F0 is placed third only because of the added chevron, not because of any corner-rounding difference I could confirm
